entry.title: Bayside Bandit 1.0
entry.summary: A 16-bit crime caper starring a masked raccoon. The menu offers New Game, Continue, Free Roam, Mission Select and a Pursuit Challenge.

entry.title: Golf Solitaire 1.0
entry.summary: Two classic card games, Golf and Klondike, on one Game Boy Advance cartridge. Press Start at the title screen.

entry.title: Jacks or Better! 1.0
entry.summary: Solitaire and casino card games for the Super Nintendo, with a joker mascot and a pay table.

entry.title: Lumi's Tower 1.0
entry.summary: A puzzle game with a lantern. You choose a save slot (five puzzles and one lantern in slot 1) with Up and Down, then press A to start.

entry.title: Pip's Pizza Panic 1.0
entry.summary: A bright 16-bit arcade game starring Pip the penguin, shown over a sunset town with pizzas. Press A or Start at the title screen.

entry.title: The Borrowed Hour 1.0
entry.summary: Spend stolen minutes to make an impossible connection. A Game Boy Advance story game; press A or Start on the title screen.

entry.title: Wildwood 1.0
entry.summary: A survival story for the Game Boy Advance. This is version 0.4. Choose Play or Settings from the title menu.

entry.title: Button Check 1.0
entry.summary: A one-screen test cartridge: the screen turns red while the A button is held and green otherwise. Handy for checking that a keyboard, controller or the on-screen touch buttons reach the game.

entry.title: Palette Explorer 1.0
entry.summary: Walk through the 64 colours the NES can show. The whole screen takes the colour you pick, so you can see exactly what a game artist had to work with. Written in 172 bytes of 6502 machine code; the Python script that builds it is included.

entry.title: Sprite Lab 1.0
entry.summary: First release: a four-sprite robot, ten balls on one line with switchable flicker, two-screen scrolling and three sound channels.
